company.description: Truva Kalıp AŞ specializes in the design and manufacturing of molds and machine parts, catering to various sectors including automotive, white goods, defense, and aerospace. The company is equipped with a robust machine line and employs quality benchmarks for all its products, ensuring precision and durability. Truva Kalıp AŞ also offers personalized services to meet the specific needs of its clients, ranging from tool and parts production to comprehensive support for new programs. With a focus on innovation and customer satisfaction, Truva Kalıp AŞ aims to fulfill the demands of its diverse clientele efficiently.
